en: Black‑and‑white view of a European riverside city with ornate baroque and historicist buildings to the left, a quay with people walking and horse‑drawn trams or early electric trams on tracks in the center, and numerous steamships moored along the river to the right. In the background a large classical opera‑house‑like building stands near a multi‑arched stone bridge that crosses the river, and a tall clock‑tower rises beyond it. The image has wide white margins and the framing and subject suggest it is an old postcard or photographic print.
